about: scripts/specrefs mutants: the spec-reference scan that reads wrapped comment lines and Markdown paragraphs whole (batch 18 verify M3).

mutants.name: specrefs-lines-unjoined
mutants.rule: A reference wrapped across two comment lines is one reference: a renumbering finds and moves it.

mutants.name: specrefs-move-first-only
mutants.rule: A renumbering moves every number of a reference (Lowering 9 and 2), all at once.
